answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 81 keys loses far more than 81 single identities would. The nebula graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the pulse audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the pearl checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
